iresearch-26.09: Written in C++. SereneDB's search engine, derived from IResearch.
Index is read from disk via mmap.
Doc deltas, frequencies and positions are encoded using FOR-delta and blocks of size 128.

A term whose postings span more than one block carries a skip list, written after its blocks: docs and frequencies alternate per block, then the skip list. It has up to 5 levels with a fan-out of 32, and every entry carries the score bounds of the range it covers.
Execution is organised around blocks and windows rather than a single doc-at-a-time cursor, closer to how an OLAP engine runs a pipeline than to a classic inverted-index iterator.

Doc-at-a-time, window-at-a-time and term-at-a-time evaluation all exist, and all three apply to disjunction, conjunction and exclusion alike. The planner picks by cost; term-at-a-time is only eligible when the command needs no scores, since it abandons document order.

Scores are computed a block at a time: the inputs for a block of matches are gathered first, then the whole block is scored in one pass. A disjunction over postings skips the gather, because each term's block is read in full anyway, and accumulates its contributions straight into the block's scores.
Implements block-max WAND / block-max MaxScore for top-k commands, which also score by block.
Every root command is a separate operator, one each for count, docs, scored, top-k and offsets, rather than one iterator adapted by a flag.
Within a plan, nodes take distinct roles: a lead drives the iteration, probes are tested against the candidates the lead produces, and fill nodes materialize the matches of a whole window.
The scoring model is abstract: BM25 is one scorer among several, and its parameters are part of the query rather than the codec.
lucene-10.5: Index is read from disk via mmap.
Doc IDs are encoded as bit sets on dense blocks and FOR-delta otherwise, frequencies and position deltas are encoded using PFOR. Block size is 128.
2 levels of skip data, every 128 and 4,096 docs, inlined in postings.
Impacts are decomposed into pareto-optimal (freq, norm) pairs, stored within skip data.
Implements vectorized variants of block-max MAXSCORE and block-max AND for top-k commands.
Disjunctions and dense conjunctions reorder/count matching doc IDs using bit sets over windows of 4,096 docs.
tantivy-0.26: Index is read from disk via mmap.
Doc deltas, frequencies and positions are encoded using FOR-delta and blocks of size 128.
Single level of skip data inlined into postings, every 128 docs.
Impacts are inlined into skip data as an approximation only the optimal `(term_freq, norm)` pair for the block is stored.
This argmax is computed assuming the current segment statistics. During search, these args are reinjected into the BM25 formula with the global statistics.
Implements block-max WAND / block-max AND for top-k commands.
Disjunctions reorder/count matching doc IDs using bit sets over windows of 4,096 docs.
